column1: # grade_profiles.tsv - per-map colour-grade multipliers over the HZM ACES baseline
# 5.1). USER DECISION 3: per-map grade ON by default, with a player toggle off; the
# player's own r_pp* sliders are NEVER written.
# This is DATA ONLY. The grade is not applied by any engine or script code yet, and
# nothing in this change wires it. The research (2.2) specifies the shipping shape,
# which is a LATER engine step:
#      cvars r_ppMapGrade (0/1 active) + r_ppMapExpo/Cont/Sat/Temp. After the preset
#      switch, COMPOSE over whatever the player produced:
#          expo *= mapExpo;  cont *= mapCont;  sat *= mapSat;  temp += mapTemp;
#      and open the tonemap gate when r_ppMapGrade is active. NEVER write r_pp* (that
#      stomps player settings - the bug-2165 class).
#   2. cgame: parse ONE packed cvar  coop_mapGrade "<expo>,<cont>,<sat>,<temp>"  that
#      the server publishes change-only (like coop_daylight), check the player's
#      opt-out (r_ppMapGradeOn, archived, default 1 - a NON-coop_ name so a server
#      cannot flip it), publish the r_ppMap* cvars, and RESET to neutral at CG_Init
#      so a later MP server that never publishes carries no coop grade.
#   3. server: publish this table's row for the current coop map at spawn/join. Keyed
#      by level.coop_mapname (lowercase), exactly like the fog profiles.
# HARD PREREQUISITE (research 2.2 / 0.3): the CG_CoopDaylightThink first-frame reset
# (bug-2584) must be fixed first, or the multipliers apply to a tonemap path that is
# off. Opening the gate also switches the curve from rend2 Hable+auto-exposure to
# ACES+fixed exposure - a global look change - so FOG COLOURS MUST BE TUNED AFTER that
# switch, or every fog profile is retuned twice.
# MP isolation (research 6): the relay must avoid coop_mp* tokens (check_mp_isolation
# clause 14) and reset at CG_Init (flags-0 cvars persist across server switches within
# COLUMNS (multipliers over ACES-neutral, i.e. preset 1 = expo 1.0, cont 1.05, sat 1.0,
#   expo  exposure multiplier   contrast  contrast multiplier   sat  saturation mult
#   temp  ADDITIVE temperature tint (warm +, cool -), clamped [-0.12,+0.10]
# source = pilot   -> exact hand-tuned pilot value (research section 4). Six maps.
#        = derived -> from the research 5.1 draft-grade method:
#            temp = clamp(0.5*(R-B)/(R+G+B), -0.12, +0.10) over the map's fog/horizon
#              colour (the value in fog_profiles.tsv, or the measured horizon on maps
#            expo = 1.00 (no expo term in the method).
# EVERY derived row is a DRAFT and needs eyes (research 5.2: saturation vs gore and
# enemy-uniform readability against snow/sand, night glow, interiors). Grades are ON
# by default per USER DECISION 3, so this table covers ALL 65 coop maps - including the
# no-fog maps, which still get a grade.
